scope: Measurement references only; no GPU benchmark or source changes

sources.title: NVIDIA CUDA 11.3 Driver API Event Management
NVIDIA CUDA 11.3 Driver API Execution Control

measurement_constraints: Enable timing on both events, record them around the kernel in the same default stream, then wait for completion before reading elapsed milliseconds.
Create/destroy measurement events outside the device interval; account for profiler overhead in total request wall time.
No simultaneous regression/build/API benchmark jobs. Cold module/context costs and warm execution are separate observations.
Host wall time also covers preparation, allocations/transfers, result formatting and cleanup. Existing elapsed_ms excludes some of these phases and is not a complete request or device-only measure.
